title: EC_SSP2_BAU
description: SSP2-NPi2025: This National Policies Implemented (NPi) scenario follows the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways 2 called Middle of the Road. The NPi reflects currently implemented policies, while fulfilling near-term feasibility and long-term plausibility assessments. Emissions trajectories are aligned with bottom-up studies on the effect of currently implemented policies. Carbon prices are constant in the mid- and long-term.

description: SSP2-NDC: This Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) scenario follows the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways 2 called Middle of the Road. It assumes NPi2025 until 2025 and has start year 2030. The NDC includes all pledged policies even if not yet implemented. It assumes that the moderate and heterogeneous climate ambition reflected in the NDCs at the begining of 2021 continues over the 21st century.

title: EC_SSP2_BAU_PkBudg750

description: SSP2-PkBudg750: This climate policy scenario follows the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways 2 called Middle of the Road. The stylized climate policy scenario assumes a peak budget of 750 Gt CO2 on total CO2 emissions from 2015 to 2100. This is a 1.5C scenario, peak warming is allowed to be at or slightly above 1.5C at median climate sensitivity but returns to values below 1.5C in at least 67 % of scenarios by the end of the century.

description: EC_SSP1_OC without new demand calibration: Orchestrated Commons climate-policy scenario based on SSP1-PkBudg750 with a 750 GtCO2 peak budget. Relative to SSP1-PkBudg750, it applies uniform global carbon pricing, a less restrictive geological CO2 injection constraint, and modified biomass assumptions: global biomass use is subject to an upper bound of ~150 EJ/yr, purpose-grown lignocellulosic biomass faces a 175% sustainability tax at 200 EJ/yr, and biomass trade costs are reduced to 50% of default.
